title: Return compact micro/short hits built from FTS candidates, capped at 8 memories per response, gated
body:
Return compact micro/short hits built from FTS candidates, capped at 8 memories per response, gated by a value-per-token threshold (default 0.02, config vpt_threshold). Use the `get` tool only when full evidence/relations for one specific memory are needed. Do not name a specific internal function (e.g. a helper inside retrieve.js) in this memory's content — describe the externally-observable contract instead, so a later refactor of the internal shape doesn't leave the memory citing code that no longer exists.

Why: The existing active memory on this topic_key (b8f17c0c) is stale in two ways found during a full memory-store audit: it names a `compactHit` helper in src/engine/retrieve.js that no longer exists (retrieve.js now builds the hit object inline in the candidate loop), and it uses the pre-rename tool names `supermem_retrieve`/`supermem_get` instead of the current `orient`/`retrieve`/`get` MCP tools. Its evidence_state freshness check reported no drift because the cited file's hash hadn't changed since last verification — hash-based freshness checks provenance, not whether the memory's prose description of the code is still accurate, so this kind of staleness needs a human or an explicit audit pass to catch.

evidence.summary: Hit objects are built inline in the candidate loop (~line 91), capped at 8 selected memories, gated by the value-per-token threshold check.
Current MCP tool names are orient/retrieve/get/propose/feedback/list/contradict/ui/status/health, not supermem_*.

v1.trigger: when calling the DD retrieve/orient tools, or changing retrieveMemories in src/engine/retrieve.js
